name: Nanai
source:
A nice gentleman who shows up to help Kakei Kyoutaro and the rest of the cast out sometimes.

[spoiler]His real name before he was a shepherd is Kakei Asahiko (筧 朝彦), Kyoutarou's father.[/spoiler]
